verdict.rationale: Graphite offers programmatic surfaces only for part of its product. The gt CLI handles stacking and branch operations (graphite-docs-3, graphite-docs-39), and GT MCP lets agents create stacked PRs (graphite-docs-30, graphite-probe-4). There is no evidence of a public API covering the rest of the UI: probes found no OpenAPI spec (graphite-probe-3). AI review setup is described as 'a few clicks' in the UI (graphite-docs-18), and disabling AI org-wide requires emailing support (graphite-docs-32). Missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API or OpenAPI spec, programmatic access to AI review configuration, merge queue, Insights, Chat and Agents, and any statement or evidence of API–UI parity.
